name: Olympas
title: Faithful Co-worker in Rome
summary: Olympas was a Christian in the church at Rome whom Paul greets in his letter to the Romans. He is mentioned alongside other believers as part of the Christian community in the capital, testifying to the spread of the gospel to the heart of the Roman Empire.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a personal greeting to Olympas in his letter to the church at Rome, showing that Olympas was known and respected in the early Christian community.

keyEvents.title: Part of the House Church
keyEvents.description: Olympas is mentioned together with Phlegon, Julia, Nereus and his sister, as well as all the saints who are with them, suggesting that he was part of a house church in Rome.
